791: ਘਰੁ ਦਰੁ ਪਾਵੈ ਮਹਲੁ; ਨਾਮੁ ਪਿਆਰਿਆ ॥
Loving the Lord's Name, he finds the Lord's home, door and mansion.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਾਇਆ ਨਾਮੁ; ਹਉ. ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Guru; the Lord's Name is found only through the Guru.
O Creator, You Yourself, setting beings on the Guru's path, make their lives beautiful. ॥16॥
When a lamp is lit, darkness departs;
so too an intellect moulded by the teaching of the Vedas and other scriptures destroys sins.
When the sun rises, the moon is not seen;
so where the intellect is illumined with wisdom, ignorance is wiped out.
Mere recitation of the Vedas and other scriptures is just worldly business;
the learned read and read them and only reflect on their meanings.
Until the intellect is changed, mere reading and reflection only bring people to ruin.
Nanak: only the one who has handed his intellect over to the Guru crosses beyond the darkness of sin. ॥1॥
ਸਬਦੈ ਸਾਦੁ. ਨ ਆਇਓ; ਨਾਮਿ. ਨ ਲਗੋ ਪਿਆਰੁ ॥
The one who has never tasted the relish of the Guru's Word, whose love for the Lord's Name never formed,
ਰਸਨਾ ਫਿਕਾ ਬੋਲਣਾ; ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਹੋਇ ਖੁਆਰੁ ॥
speaks insipid words with the tongue and is ever ruined.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਇਐ ਕਿਰਤਿ ਕਮਾਵਣਾ; ਕੋਇ. ਨ ਮੇਟਣਹਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
But Nanak, what can such a one do? Each being acts according to the imprints gathered from past deeds, and no one can erase this cycle by his own effort. ॥2॥
ਜਿ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਸਾਲਾਹੇ ਆਪਣਾ; ਸੋ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਏ ॥
The one who praises his Lord earns glory.
ਹਉਮੈ ਵਿਚਹੁ ਦੂਰਿ ਕਰਿ; ਸਚੁ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
Removing ego from the mind, he enshrines the eternal Lord there.
ਸਚੁ ਬਾਣੀ ਗੁਣ ਉਚਰੈ; ਸਚਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਏ ॥
Through the Guru's Bani he utters the Lord's virtues and remembers the Name, and so enjoys true comfort.
ਮੇਲੁ ਭਇਆ ਚਿਰੀ ਵਿਛੁੰਨਿਆ; ਗੁਰ ਪੁਰਖਿ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥
Long separated from the Lord, he is united with Him again, for the Guru, the true Man, has united him.
ਮਨੁ ਮੈਲਾ ਇਵ ਸੁਧੁ ਹੈ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਏ ॥੧੭॥
So, remembering the Lord's Name, the soiled mind is made pure in this way. ॥17॥
ਕਾਇਆ ਕੂਮਲ ਫੁਲ ਗੁਣ; ਨਾਨਕ. ਗੁਪਸਿ ਮਾਲ ॥
Nanak: the body is like the tender shoot of a flowering plant, and the Lord's virtues are its flowers; some fortunate one strings them into a garland.
ਏਨੀ ਫੁਲੀ ਰਉ ਕਰੇ; ਅਵਰ. ਕਿ ਚੁਣੀਅਹਿ ਡਾਲ ॥੧॥
If one becomes devoted to these flowers, what need is there to pick other branches to offer before idols? ॥1॥
ਨਾਨਕ ਤਿਨਾ ਬਸੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਜਿਨੑ ਘਰਿ ਵਸਿਆ ਕੰਤੁ ॥
Nanak: spring has come for those brides whose husband dwells at home;
ਜਿਨ ਕੇ ਕੰਤ ਦਿਸਾਪੁਰੀ; ਸੇ ਅਹਿਨਿਸਿ, ਫਿਰਹਿ, ਜਲੰਤ ॥੨॥
but those whose husbands have gone to foreign lands go about burning day and night. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਬਖਸੇ ਦਇਆ ਕਰਿ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਬਚਨੀ ॥
Joining beings to the Bani of the Guru, the True Guru, God Himself in His mercy blesses them with the Name.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਸੇਵੀ ਗੁਣ ਰਵਾ; ਮਨੁ ਸਚੈ ਰਚਨੀ ॥
O Lord, have mercy, that at all times I may remember You, dwell on Your virtues, and keep my mind joined to You, the True One.
ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਮੇਰਾ ਬੇਅੰਤੁ ਹੈ; ਅੰਤੁ. ਕਿਨੈ ਨ ਲਖਨੀ ॥
My Lord is infinite; no being has found His end.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਚਰਣੀ ਲਗਿਆ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਤ ਜਪਨੀ ॥
Falling at the Guru's feet, the Lord's Name can be ever remembered.
ਜੋ ਇਛੈ ਸੋ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਸੀ; ਸਭਿ ਘਰੈ ਵਿਚਿ ਜਚਨੀ ॥੧੮॥
The one who remembers Him has all needs met within his own home and obtains whatever fruit he longs for. ॥18॥
ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ; ਪਹਿਲਾ ਮਉਲਿਓ ਸੋਇ ॥
The Lord who was before the coming of spring is the One who blossomed first of all.
ਜਿਤੁ ਮਉਲਿਐ. ਸਭ ਮਉਲੀਐ; ਤਿਸਹਿ. ਨ ਮਉਲਿਹੁ ਕੋਇ ॥੧॥
Through His blossoming all creation blossoms, but no one else makes Him blossom. ॥1॥
ਪਹਿਲ ਬਸੰਤੈ ਆਗਮਨਿ; ਤਿਸ ਕਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ ॥
Reflect on the virtues of the Lord who was before the coming of spring, through whose blessing the whole world blossoms.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਸੋ ਸਾਲਾਹੀਐ; ਜਿ ਸਭਸੈ ਦੇ ਆਧਾਰੁ ॥੨॥
Nanak: remember that Lord who is the support of all. ॥2॥
ਮਿਲਿਐ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਨਾ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮਿਲੈ ਮਿਲਿਆ ਜੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
Merely saying "I am united" does not bring union; union comes only if one is truly united.
ਅੰਤਰ ਆਤਮੈ ਜੋ ਮਿਲੈ; ਮਿਲਿਆ ਕਹੀਐ ਸੋਇ ॥੩॥
The one who is united within the soul should be called united. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਸਚੁ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
Remember the Lord's Name; the one who takes to remembrance ever does this true work.
ਦੂਜੀ ਕਾਰੈ ਲਗਿਆ; ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨੀ ਪਾਵੈ ॥
Absorbed in pursuits other than the Name, one falls into the species again and again.
ਨਾਮਿ ਰਤਿਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਨਾਮੇ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
Joined to the Name, one earns only the Name and sings the Lord's praises alone.
ਗੁਰ ਕੈ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਲਾਹੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਵੈ ॥
The one who has praised Him through the Guru's Word stays merged in the Lord's Name.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਹੈ; ਸੇਵਿਐ ਫਲ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੧੯॥
Walking in the Guru's command is most fruitful; walking in it, one obtains the fruit of the wealth of the Name. ॥19॥
ਕਿਸ ਹੀ ਕੋਈ ਕੋਇ; ਮੰਞੁ ਨਿਮਾਣੀ ਇਕੁ ਤੂ ॥
O Lord, some have one false support and some another; for me, the humble one, there is only You.
792: ਕਿਉ. ਨ ਮਰੀਜੈ ਰੋਇ; ਜਾ ਲਗੁ ਚਿਤਿ. ਨ ਆਵਹੀ ॥੧॥
As long as You do not dwell in my mind, why should I not die weeping? Forgetting You, one only wastes away in pain. ॥1॥
ਜਾਂ ਸੁਖੁ. ਤਾ ਸਹੁ ਰਾਵਿਓ; ਦੁਖਿ ਭੀ ਸੰਮੑਾਲਿਓਇ ॥
If there is comfort, remember the Husband-Lord; in pain too, keep the Master in mind.
ਨਾਨਕੁ ਕਹੈ ਸਿਆਣੀਏ; ਇਉ ਕੰਤ ਮਿਲਾਵਾ ਹੋਇ ॥੨॥
Then, Nanak says, O wise soul-bride, in this way union with the Husband comes about. ॥2॥
ਹਉ. ਕਿਆ ਸਾਲਾਹੀ ਕਿਰਮ ਜੰਤੁ; ਵਡੀ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
O Lord, I am a mere worm and Your greatness is vast; which of Your virtues can I describe?
ਤੂ ਅਗਮ ਦਇਆਲੁ ਅਗੰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਆਪਿ ਲੈਹਿ ਮਿਲਾਈ ॥
You are most merciful and beyond reach; You Yourself unite beings with Yourself.
ਮੈ. ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਬੇਲੀ ਕੋ ਨਹੀ; ਤੂ ਅੰਤਿ ਸਖਾਈ ॥
I see no friend but You; in the end You alone come to my aid as a companion.
ਜੋ ਤੇਰੀ ਸਰਣਾਗਤੀ; ਤਿਨ ਲੈਹਿ ਛਡਾਈ ॥
Whoever comes to Your refuge, You save from the cycle of ego.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਵੇਪਰਵਾਹੁ ਹੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਤਿਲੁ. ਨ ਤਮਾਈ ॥੨੦॥੧॥
Nanak: the Lord Himself is carefree and has not the slightest greed. ॥20॥1॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਕਬੀਰ ਜੀਉ. ਤਥਾ ਸਭਨਾ ਭਗਤਾ ਕੀ ॥ ਕਬੀਰ ਕੇ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Having come into the world and taken birth, what have you done? You have earned nothing.
ਰਾਮ ਕੋ ਨਾਮੁ; ਨ ਕਬਹੂ ਲੀਨਾ ॥੧॥
You have never remembered the Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਰਾਮ ਨ ਜਪਹੁ; ਕਵਨ ਮਤਿ ਲਾਗੇ ॥
You do not remember the Lord; what evil counsel are you following?
ਮਰਿ ਜਇਬੇ ਕਉ; ਕਿਆ ਕਰਹੁ ਅਭਾਗੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O unfortunate one, what preparation are you making for the time of death? ॥1॥ Rahao
ਦੁਖ ਸੁਖ ਕਰਿ ਕੈ; ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਜੀਵਾਇਆ ॥
Enduring many hardships, all your life you kept supporting your family,
but at the time of death you must bear the pain of your misdeeds alone. ॥2॥
When Death seizes you by the throat, crying and wailing will be of no use;
ਕਹਿ ਕਬੀਰ; ਆਗੇ ਤੇ. ਨ ਸੰਮੑਾਰਾ ॥੩॥੧॥
Kabir says: why do you not remember the Lord before that time comes? ॥3॥1॥
Because my life has passed without devotion, my innocent soul trembles in fear,
not knowing how the Husband-Lord will deal with me. ॥1॥
ਰੈਨਿ ਗਈ; ਮਤ ਦਿਨੁ ਭੀ ਜਾਇ ॥
The night of my youth has passed without repeating the Lord's Name; I fear the day of old age may pass the same way.
ਭਵਰ ਗਏ; ਬਗ ਬੈਠੇ ਆਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The bumblebees, my black hairs, have gone, and the cranes, white hairs, have come to settle. ॥1॥ Rahao
I never thought this body is like an unbaked pot; water cannot stay in an unbaked pitcher.
My breaths have run out; the body is withering and the swan-soul is ready to fly, yet I have set nothing right. ॥2॥
As an unmarried girl may go on adorning herself,
yet without the husband she cannot enjoy these adornments, so I spent my life caring only for the body and, forgetting the Lord, found no spiritual comfort. ॥3॥
O Husband-Lord, come and meet me now; waiting for You, my arm is tired from shooing away crows,
Kabir says, and the story of my life is coming to an end. ॥4॥2॥
O soul, your term of service in the world, your appointed span, is over, and you must give account of what you did here;
the harsh messengers of Death have come to take you.
They will ask: what have you earned while living here, and where have you squandered it?
Come quickly; the Judge of righteousness has summoned you. ॥1॥
Come at once; the Judge of righteousness has summoned you;
ਹਰਿ ਫੁਰਮਾਨੁ; ਦਰਗਹ ਕਾ ਆਇਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the Lord's command has come from His court. ॥1॥ Rahao
I plead that some of the village accounts are still outstanding;
if you permit, I will settle them tonight,
arrange something for your expenses too,
and say my morning prayer on the road, setting out with you very early. ॥2॥
ਸਾਧਸੰਗਿ; ਜਾ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਰੰਗੁ ਲਾਗਾ ॥
The one who, in the holy congregation, receives the Lord's love
ਧਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ; ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਭਾਗਾ ॥
The Lord's servants are at ease in this world and the next,
for they win this priceless treasure of human life. ॥3॥
The one who, though awake, stays asleep in Maya's slumber wastes this human life,
for all the goods and wealth he gathered become another's in the end.
Kabir says: those people have gone astray;
those who forgot the Husband-Lord have been ground into the dust. ॥4॥3॥
793: ਥਾਕੇ ਨੈਨ. ਸ੍ਰਵਨ ਸੁਨਿ ਥਾਕੇ; ਥਾਕੀ ਸੁੰਦਰਿ ਕਾਇਆ ॥
Your eyes have grown weak, your ears no longer hear, and your beautiful body has worn out;
ਜਰਾ ਹਾਕ ਦੀ. ਸਭ ਮਤਿ ਥਾਕੀ; ਏਕ. ਨ ਥਾਕਸਿ ਮਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
old age has called out and your whole intellect no longer works, yet the pull of Maya alone has not ended. ॥1॥
ਬਾਵਰੇ ਤੈ; ਗਿਆਨ ਬੀਚਾਰੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
O crazed one, you have not gained the understanding to know the Lord;
you have wasted your whole life. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤਬ ਲਗੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ ਤਿਸੈ ਸਰੇਵਹੁ; ਜਬ ਲਗੁ ਘਟ ਮਹਿ ਸਾਸਾ ॥
O mortal, as long as breath runs in the body, remember that Lord alone.
ਜੇ ਘਟੁ ਜਾਇ. ਤ ਭਾਉ ਨ ਜਾਸੀ; ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਨ ਨਿਵਾਸਾ ॥੨॥
Love Him so that even if the body perishes the love does not lessen, and the mind stays at the Lord's feet. ॥2॥
ਜਿਸ ਕਉ ਸਬਦੁ ਬਸਾਵੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ; ਚੂਕੈ ਤਿਸਹਿ ਪਿਆਸਾ ॥
The one in whose mind the Lord Himself makes the Bani of His praise dwell has his thirst for Maya quenched.
ਹੁਕਮੈ ਬੂਝੈ ਚਉਪੜਿ ਖੇਲੈ; ਮਨੁ ਜਿਣਿ ਢਾਲੇ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੩॥
He understands the Lord's will and plays the game of chaupar, accepting His will; conquering the mind is his throw of the dice. ॥3॥
ਜੋ ਜਨ ਜਾਨਿ ਭਜਹਿ, ਅਬਿਗਤ ਕਉ; ਤਿਨ ਕਾ. ਕਛੂ ਨ ਨਾਸਾ ॥
Those who form kinship with the unseen Lord and remember Him do not lose their lives in vain.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਤੇ ਜਨ ਕਬਹੁ, ਨ ਹਾਰਹਿ; ਢਾਲਿ ਜੁ ਜਾਨਹਿ ਪਾਸਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Kabir says: those who know how to throw the dice of remembrance never lose the game of life. ॥4॥4॥
ਏਕੁ ਕੋਟੁ ਪੰਚ ਸਿਕਦਾਰਾ; ਪੰਚੇ ਮਾਗਹਿ ਹਾਲਾ ॥
This human body is a fortress in which five chiefs, lust and the rest, dwell; all five demand revenue from it, that is, these five vices torment it.
ਜਿਮੀ. ਨਾਹੀ ਮੈ ਕਿਸੀ ਕੀ ਬੋਈ; ਐਸਾ ਦੇਨੁ ਦੁਖਾਲਾ ॥੧॥
But by my Guru's grace I have become no one's tenant and tilled no one's land, so paying them revenue is hard for me; none of these vices could lead me astray. ॥1॥
ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਲੋਗਾ; ਮੋ ਕਉ ਨੀਤਿ ਡਸੈ ਪਟਵਾਰੀ ॥
O people of the Lord, I live in constant dread of the revenue clerk, fearing that, should the vices prevail, an account of misdeeds may begin to be written within me.
ਊਪਰਿ ਭੁਜਾ ਕਰਿ. ਮੈ ਗੁਰ ਪਹਿ ਪੁਕਾਰਿਆ; ਤਿਨਿ ਹਉ ਲੀਆ ਉਬਾਰੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
So, raising my arm, I cried out to my Guru, and he saved me from them. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਨਉ ਡਾਡੀ. ਦਸ ਮੁੰਸਫ ਧਾਵਹਿ; ਰਈਅਤਿ ਬਸਨ. ਨ ਦੇਹੀ ॥
The nine openings of the body, like surveyors, and the ten senses, like magistrates, so assail a person's life that they do not let the subjects, the good virtues within, settle there.
ਡੋਰੀ ਪੂਰੀ. ਮਾਪਹਿ ਨਾਹੀ; ਬਹੁ ਬਿਸਟਾਲਾ ਲੇਹੀ ॥੨॥
These surveyors do not measure with a full chain and take heavy bribes; they entangle a person in sense-pleasures and lust beyond all proper bounds. ॥2॥
ਬਹਤਰਿ ਘਰ, ਇਕੁ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਸਮਾਇਆ; ਉਨਿ ਦੀਆ ਨਾਮੁ ਲਿਖਾਈ ॥
When I cried out to my Guru, he wrote out for me as my pass the Name of the one Lord who dwells within this body of seventy-two chambers.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕਾ ਦਫਤਰੁ ਸੋਧਿਆ; ਬਾਕੀ ਰਿਜਮ ਨ ਕਾਈ ॥੩॥
By the Guru's grace, when the records of the Judge of righteousness were checked, nothing at all was found owing from me. ॥3॥
ਸੰਤਾ ਕਉ. ਮਤਿ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦਹੁ; ਸੰਤ ਰਾਮੁ ਹੈ ਏਕੋੁ ॥
This blessing comes from the company of the saints; let no one ever slander the saints, for the saints and the Lord are one.
ਕਹੁ ਕਬੀਰ. ਮੈ ਸੋ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਜਾ ਕਾ ਨਾਉ ਬਿਬੇਕੋੁ ॥੪॥੫॥
Kabir says: I too have found that saintly Guru who is perfect in wisdom. ॥4॥5॥
ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸ੍ਰੀ ਰਵਿਦਾਸ ਜੀਉ ਕੀ ॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
Only the bride who loves her Husband knows the worth of union with the Husband-Lord.
Giving up pride and joining herself to the Lord's feet, she enjoys the bliss of that union.
ਤਨੁ ਮਨੁ ਦੇਇ; ਨ ਅੰਤਰੁ ਰਾਖੈ ॥
She hands her body and mind over to the Husband-Lord and keeps no distance from Him.
She looks to no other for support and listens to no one's evil counsel. ॥1॥
How can she understand this pain in the hearts of other, devoted brides,
ਜਾ ਕੈ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਦਰਦੁ; ਨ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
the bride in whose heart the ache of separation from the Lord has never arisen? ॥1॥ Rahao
The forsaken bride stays miserable, deprived in both her parents' home and her in-laws', this world and the next,
ਜਿਨਿ ਨਾਹ ਨਿਰੰਤਰਿ; ਭਗਤਿ. ਨ ਕੀਨੀ ॥
she who did not worship her Husband-Lord steadily.
For her the path of life becomes as hard as the narrow bridge of Pursalat;
in its sorrows no one becomes her companion or friend, and she must travel the whole journey alone. ॥2॥
O Lord, in pain and sorrow I have come to Your door.
I long deeply for the sight of You, but no answer comes from Your door.
Ravidas says: O Lord, I have come to Your refuge;
ਜਿਉ ਜਾਨਹੁ; ਤਿਉ ਕਰੁ ਗਤਿ ਮੇਰੀ ॥੩॥੧॥
as You know best, so set my state right. ॥3॥1॥
ਜੋ ਦਿਨ ਆਵਹਿ; ਸੋ ਦਿਨ ਜਾਹੀ ॥
Each day that comes in a person's life is also passing, and is taken from the span of life.
Everyone must depart from here; no one has a permanent dwelling.
ਸੰਗੁ ਚਲਤ ਹੈ; ਹਮ ਭੀ ਚਲਨਾ ॥
Our companions are leaving, and we too must go.
It is a long journey, and death stands over our heads; who knows when it will come. ॥1॥
794: O ignorant one, wake up! Why are you sleeping?
ਤੈ ਜੀਵਨੁ ਜਗਿ; ਸਚੁ ਕਰਿ ਜਾਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
You have taken this life in the world to be permanent. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜਿਨਿ ਜੀਉ ਦੀਆ; ਸੁ ਰਿਜਕੁ ਅੰਬਰਾਵੈ ॥
You are always anxious about sustenance, but look: the Lord who gave you life also provides sustenance.
Seated in all bodies, He Himself sets up the means of sustenance.
Give up "I am so great, I own so much"; worship the Lord.
While there is still time, keep His Name safe in your heart. ॥2॥
Life is coming to an end, yet you have not made your path right.
Evening is falling, and darkness is about to cover all ten directions.
you do not remember the Lord, and the world to which you have tied your mind will perish in the end. ॥3॥2॥
Even if one has lofty brick mansions and kitchens, what of it?
ਏਕ ਘਰੀ ਫੁਨਿ ਰਹਨੁ. ਨ ਹੋਈ ॥੧॥
When death comes, one is not allowed to stay in them even a moment longer. ॥1॥
ਇਹੁ ਤਨੁ ਐਸਾ; ਜੈਸੇ ਘਾਸ ਕੀ ਟਾਟੀ ॥
Let alone brick houses, this body itself is like a hut of grass.
ਜਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਘਾਸੁ; ਰਲਿ ਗਇਓ ਮਾਟੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The grass burns and mixes with the dust; so it is with the body. ॥1॥ Rahao
When a person dies, relatives, family and friends,
all of them begin to say: take him out quickly now. ॥2॥
ਘਰ ਕੀ ਨਾਰਿ; ਉਰਹਿ ਤਨ ਲਾਗੀ ॥
Even his own wife, who always clung to him,
ਉਹ ਤਉ; ਭੂਤੁ ਭੂਤੁ ਕਰਿ ਭਾਗੀ ॥੩॥
draws away crying: he is dead now, he is dead. ॥3॥
Ravidas says: the whole world, taking body, property and relatives as its own, is being robbed,
ਹਮ ਤਉ; ਏਕ ਰਾਮੁ ਕਹਿ ਛੂਟਿਆ ॥੪॥੩॥
but I have been saved from this deception by remembering the one Lord's Name. ॥4॥3॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਰਾਗੁ ਸੂਹੀ ਬਾਣੀ ਸੇਖ ਫਰੀਦ ਜੀ ਕੀ ॥
ਤਪਿ ਤਪਿ ਲੁਹਿ ਲੁਹਿ; ਹਾਥ ਮਰੋਰਉ ॥
In anguish and torment I now wring my hands,
and, half crazed, I go searching for that Husband.
ਤੈ ਸਹਿ ਮਨ ਮਹਿ; ਕੀਆ ਰੋਸੁ ॥
O Husband-Lord, that is why You were displeased with me in Your mind.
The fault for my wretched state is not Yours; the faults were in me. ॥1॥
ਤੈ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਕੀ; ਮੈ ਸਾਰ. ਨ ਜਾਨੀ ॥
O my Master, I did not know Your worth.
Having wasted my youth, I now regret it afterwards. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਾਲੀ ਕੋਇਲ; ਤੂ ਕਿਤ ਗੁਨ ਕਾਲੀ ॥
Now I go asking the koel: O black koel, I am wretched from my own deeds, but why have you become black?
ਅਪਨੇ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਮ ਕੇ; ਹਉ ਬਿਰਹੈ ਜਾਲੀ ॥
The koel too replies: separation from my Beloved has burnt me.
Indeed, separated from the Husband, where can anyone find comfort?
ਜਾ ਹੋਇ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾਲੁ; ਤਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੂ ਮਿਲਾਏ ॥੨॥
It is not in the soul-bride's power; when God Himself is merciful, He Himself unites her with Him. ॥2॥
I, the soul-bride, had fallen alone into this dreadful well of the world;
ਨਾ ਕੋ ਸਾਥੀ; ਨਾ ਕੋ ਬੇਲੀ ॥
I had no companion and no helper in my sorrows.
Now that God in His mercy has joined me to the holy congregation,
ਜਾ ਫਿਰਿ ਦੇਖਾ; ਤਾ ਮੇਰਾ ਅਲਹੁ ਬੇਲੀ ॥੩॥
when I look, I see my Lord as my helper. ॥3॥
This path of our life is truly dreadful,
sharper than a double-edged sword and very fine of edge.
So, Sheikh Farid, take care of your path early in the morning. ॥4॥1॥
ਬੇੜਾ ਬੰਧਿ. ਨ ਸਕਿਓ; ਬੰਧਨ ਕੀ ਵੇਲਾ ॥
The one who kept his mind on Maya did not build the raft of the Name in the time of life when it could be built,
ਭਰਿ ਸਰਵਰੁ ਜਬ ਊਛਲੈ; ਤਬ ਤਰਣੁ ਦੁਹੇਲਾ ॥੧॥
and when the lake fills and overflows, crossing it becomes hard; when a person has gone to the limit of vice, escaping its craving is hard. ॥1॥
ਹਥੁ. ਨ ਲਾਇ ਕਸੁੰਭੜੈ; ਜਲਿ ਜਾਸੀ ਢੋਲਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O friend, do not touch the safflower of Maya; this safflower will burn away, for Maya's company soon perishes. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਇਕ ਆਪੀਨੑੈ ਪਤਲੀ; ਸਹ ਕੇਰੇ ਬੋਲਾ ॥
The brides grown weak in spiritual life through attachment to Maya receive words of disregard from the Husband's door.
ਦੁਧਾ ਥਣੀ. ਨ ਆਵਈ; ਫਿਰਿ ਹੋਇ. ਨ ਮੇਲਾ ॥੨॥
The state of union with the Husband does not come to them, as milk does not return to the breasts; once the time of human life is missed, there is no meeting with the Lord. ॥2॥
Farid says: O friends, when the Husband-Lord's summons comes to leave this world,
ਹੰਸੁ ਚਲਸੀ ਡੁੰਮਣਾ; ਅਹਿ ਤਨੁ ਢੇਰੀ ਥੀਸੀ ॥੩॥੨॥
the soul-swan of the bride caught in Maya will depart reluctantly, and this body will become a heap of dust. ॥3॥2॥
795: ੴ ਸਤਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਰਤਾ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਨਿਰਭਉ ਨਿਰਵੈਰੁ ਅਕਾਲ ਮੂਰਤਿ ਅਜੂਨੀ ਸੈਭੰ ਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
One Creator, whose Name is Truth: the Maker, all-pervading, without fear, without enmity, beyond time, unborn, self-existent — realised by the Guru's grace.
ਤੂ ਸੁਲਤਾਨੁ. ਕਹਾ ਹਉ ਮੀਆ; ਤੇਰੀ ਕਵਨ ਵਡਾਈ ॥
O Lord, praising You I add nothing to Your greatness; it is as if You were an emperor and I called You a mere chief.
ਜੋ ਤੂ ਦੇਹਿ. ਸੁ ਕਹਾ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ. ਕਹਣੁ ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੧॥
O Master, I utter Your virtues only as far as You give me strength; I, the ignorant one, cannot describe them. ॥1॥
O Lord, grant me such understanding that I may sing Your praises,
ਜੈਸੇ ਸਚ ਮਹਿ; ਰਹਉ ਰਜਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
that, O Lord of the will, by Your praise I may stay fixed in You, the Eternal. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਹੋਆ. ਸਭੁ ਕਿਛੁ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ; ਤੇਰੀ ਸਭ ਅਸਨਾਈ ॥
Whatever has come to be in this world has all come from You; all this is Your own greatness.
ਤੇਰਾ ਅੰਤੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬ; ਮੈ ਅੰਧੁਲੇ. ਕਿਆ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥੨॥
O my Master, I cannot know the limit of Your virtues; I am blind, of little understanding; I have no such cleverness. ॥2॥
ਕਿਆ ਹਉ ਕਥੀ. ਕਥੇ ਕਥਿ ਦੇਖਾ; ਮੈ. ਅਕਥੁ, ਨ ਕਥਨਾ ਜਾਈ ॥
What can I tell? Having spoken and spoken of Your virtues, I see that You are beyond description, and I cannot describe You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ. ਸੋਈ ਆਖਾ; ਤਿਲੁ ਤੇਰੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੩॥
Whatever tiny part of Your greatness I speak, I speak only what pleases You, as far as You give me understanding. ॥3॥
ਏਤੇ ਕੂਕਰ ਹਉ. ਬੇਗਾਨਾ; ਭਉਕਾ. ਇਸੁ ਤਨ ਤਾਈ ॥
O Lord, here there are countless dogs of lust and the rest, and I am a stranger among them; whatever praise I make, I bark only to save this body of mine from them.
ਭਗਤਿ ਹੀਣੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਜੇ ਹੋਇਗਾ; ਤਾ ਖਸਮੈ ਨਾਉ. ਨ ਜਾਈ ॥੪॥੧॥
Even if Nanak is empty of devotion, You are still the protecting Master over my head, and this glory of the Master, helping those who come to His refuge, is not taken from You. ॥4॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਮੰਦਰੁ. ਤਨੁ ਵੇਸ ਕਲੰਦਰੁ; ਘਟ ਹੀ ਤੀਰਥਿ ਨਾਵਾ ॥

My mind has become the temple for the Lord to dwell in, and my senses, like a wandering ascetic, have turned from roaming outside towards the Lord within; I bathe at the pilgrimage place of the heart itself.
ਏਕੁ ਸਬਦੁ ਮੇਰੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨਿ ਬਸਤੁ ਹੈ; ਬਾਹੁੜਿ ਜਨਮਿ. ਨ ਆਵਾ ॥੧॥
The Word of the Lord's praise has settled in my soul as its support; so I am sure I shall not come into birth again. ॥1॥
ਮਨੁ ਬੇਧਿਆ. ਦਇਆਲ ਸੇਤੀ; ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O my mother, my mind has been pierced through by the feet of the Merciful Lord.
I am sure that no one but the Lord can understand another's pain.
Now I keep no hope in anyone but the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਗਮ ਅਗੋਚਰ ਅਲਖ ਅਪਾਰਾ; ਚਿੰਤਾ ਕਰਹੁ ਹਮਾਰੀ ॥
O unreachable Lord, beyond the senses, unseen and boundless, You alone take care of us all.
ਜਲਿ ਥਲਿ ਮਹੀਅਲਿ ਭਰਿਪੁਰਿ ਲੀਣਾ; ਘਟਿ ਘਟਿ ਜੋਤਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ ॥੨॥
You pervade water, land and sky to the brim; Your light is in every heart. ॥2॥
ਸਿਖ ਮਤਿ ਸਭ ਬੁਧਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ; ਮੰਦਿਰ ਛਾਵਾ ਤੇਰੇ ॥
O my Master, the minds and bodies of all beings are fashioned by You, and all instruction, wisdom and understanding come from You.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਜਾਣਾ ਮੇਰੇ ਸਾਹਿਬਾ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਾ ਨਿਤ ਤੇਰੇ ॥੩॥
I know no other equal to You, my Master; I ever sing Your virtues alone. ॥3॥
ਜੀਅ ਜੰਤ ਸਭਿ ਸਰਣਿ ਤੁਮੑਾਰੀ; ਸਰਬ ਚਿੰਤ ਤੁਧੁ ਪਾਸੇ ॥
All beings and creatures have Your support alone, and the care of them all rests with You.
ਜੋ ਤੁਧੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਸੋਈ ਚੰਗਾ; ਇਕ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੀ ਅਰਦਾਸੇ ॥੪॥੨॥
Nanak's only prayer is this: may whatever pleases You seem good to me, that I may ever stay content in Your will. ॥4॥2॥
The one who receives the Name becomes sure that the Lord Himself is the praise, present wherever He is praised, and Himself the pass on life's journey;
the Lord Himself hears beings' prayers and Himself knows their pain.
The Lord Himself made the creation and Himself beholds this power of His.
O Lord, You are the Giver of all; the one You bless with Your Name is accepted at Your door. ॥1॥
796: O immaculate, radiant Lord, Your Name is just as You are; it too frees from attachment to Maya.
ਹਉ ਜਾਚਿਕੁ; ਤੂ ਅਲਖ ਅਭੇਉ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, no mark or sign of You can be found and Your secret cannot be known; I am a beggar at Your door, asking for Your Name. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one who repeats the Name understands that attachment to Maya is like attachment to an unfaithful woman,
that Maya is like an evil woman who casts spells.
Worldly rule and beauty are perishable and last only a few days, yet under their sway people stumble in the darkness of ignorance.
The one who receives the Lord's Name finds light in the darkness of attachment to Maya. ॥2॥
I have tested this thoroughly, beyond all doubt:
the one whose father is plainly seen is not called of bad birth; the one who accepts the Father-Lord as protector does not turn to vice.
The one who has the one Father-Lord fears no one,
for he is sure that the Lord alone does everything and has it done by beings. ॥3॥
ਸਬਦਿ ਮੁਏ; ਮਨੁ. ਮਨ ਤੇ ਮਾਰਿਆ ॥
Those who, joined to the Guru's Word, end self-conceit and hold back the mind from Maya's thoughts
stay restrained from vice, for the true Creator gives their minds the support of His Name.
ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਸੂਝੈ; ਗੁਰ ਕਉ ਵਾਰਿਆ ॥
I am a sacrifice to the Guru; there is no other who helps join the mind to the Lord.
Nanak: the Lord carries across the world-ocean those dyed in His Name. ॥4॥3॥
Those whose minds, following the Guru's words, settle in the trance of poise and stop wavering towards vice,
ਹਰਿ ਕੈ ਰੰਗਿ ਰਤਾ; ਮਨੁ ਮਾਨੇ ॥
their minds, dyed in the Lord's love, stay content in His remembrance.
But the self-willed, crazed, wander in doubt and go astray.
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ. ਕਿਉ ਰਹੀਐ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਪਛਾਨੇ ॥੧॥
Those who form kinship with the Lord through the Guru's Word cannot live without His remembrance. ॥1॥
ਬਿਨੁ ਦਰਸਨ; ਕੈਸੇ ਜੀਵਉ ਮੇਰੀ ਮਾਈ ॥
O my mother, now I become restless without the sight of the Lord.
ਹਰਿ ਬਿਨੁ ਜੀਅਰਾ ਰਹਿ. ਨ ਸਕੈ ਖਿਨੁ; ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਬੂਝ ਬੁਝਾਈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Since the Guru gave me true understanding, my soul cannot live even a moment without the Lord. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮੇਰਾ ਪ੍ਰਭੁ ਬਿਸਰੈ; ਹਉ ਮਰਉ ਦੁਖਾਲੀ ॥
If ever I forget my Lord, I am about to die in pain.
ਸਾਸਿ ਗਿਰਾਸਿ ਜਪਉ; ਅਪੁਨੇ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਲੀ ॥
With every breath and every morsel I remember my Lord and keep searching for Him.
Detached from the world's pleasures, I keep my gaze on the Lord's Name alone.
In the Guru's refuge I have now understood that the Lord is ever with me. ॥2॥
The praise of the infinite Lord can be spoken only by living as the Guru teaches.
The Guru grants the sight of the Lord who is beyond the reach of the senses.
ਬਿਨੁ ਗੁਰ ਕਰਣੀ; ਕਿਆ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
Without the way of life the Guru teaches, any other work on the path of spiritual life is in vain.
ਹਉਮੈ ਮੇਟਿ ਚਲੈ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
The one joined to the Guru's Word removes ego and walks life's path. ॥3॥
The one who walks after his own mind instead of the Guru's way stays separated from the Lord; his capital for life's journey is counterfeit.
The one who turns to the Guru stays joined to the Lord's Name and receives honour.
The one whom the Lord in His mercy makes the servant of His servants,
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ; ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ਧਨੁ ਰਾਸਿ ॥੪॥੪॥
servant Nanak, receives the wealth of the Lord's Name as his capital. ॥4॥4॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਖਾਇਆ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸੋਇਆ; ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਕਾਪੜੁ ਅੰਗਿ ਚੜਾਇਆ ॥
If the Husband-Lord has not been attained through this body in this life, all one's eating is accursed, sleeping and comfort accursed, wearing clothes on the body accursed.
ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਸਰੀਰੁ ਕੁਟੰਬ ਸਹਿਤ ਸਿਉ; ਜਿਤੁ ਹੁਣਿ ਖਸਮੁ. ਨ ਪਾਇਆ ॥
Accursed is that body, along with its whole family of senses, through which the Master was not attained now.
ਪਉੜੀ ਛੁੜਕੀ ਫਿਰਿ ਹਾਥਿ, ਨ ਆਵੈ; ਅਹਿਲਾ ਜਨਮੁ ਗਵਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
This human body is the ladder to the Lord's land; once it slips from the hand it does not come back, and one has wasted a priceless life. ॥1॥
ਦੂਜਾ ਭਾਉ. ਨ ਦੇਈ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗਣਿ; ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਕੇ ਚਰਣ ਵਿਸਾਰੇ ॥
Attachment to Maya, which has made beings forget the Lord's feet, does not let the mind attune to Him.
ਜਗਜੀਵਨ ਦਾਤਾ. ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ ਤੇਰੇ; ਤਿਨ ਕੇ. ਤੈ ਦੂਖ ਨਿਵਾਰੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, Giver of spiritual life to the world, You have removed all the pains of those who become Your servants. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਤੂ ਦਇਆਲੁ. ਦਇਆਪਤਿ ਦਾਤਾ; ਕਿਆ ਏਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥
O Lord, You are the home of mercy, the Master of mercy and the Giver of love for Your feet; nothing is in the power of these poor beings.
ਮੁਕਤ ਬੰਧ ਸਭਿ ਤੁਝ ਤੇ ਹੋਏ; ਐਸਾ ਆਖਿ ਵਖਾਣੇ ॥
By Your command some are freed from attachment to Maya and some stay bound; a rare one who turns to the Guru explains this.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਮੁਕਤੁ ਕਹੀਐ; ਮਨਮੁਖ ਬੰਧ ਵਿਚਾਰੇ ॥੨॥
The one who turns to the Guru is called free of attachment, but the poor self-willed stay bound. ॥2॥
ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਮੁਕਤੁ. ਜਿਸੁ ਏਕ ਲਿਵ ਲਾਗੀ; ਸਦਾ ਰਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਲੇ ॥
The one whose attention is fixed on the One Lord is freed from attachment and stays ever joined to the Lord's feet.
ਤਿਨ ਕੀ ਗਹਣ ਗਤਿ ਕਹੀ, ਨ ਜਾਈ; ਸਚੈ ਆਪਿ ਸਵਾਰੇ ॥
The deep spiritual state of such people cannot be described; the eternal Lord Himself has made their lives beautiful.
797: ਭਰਮਿ ਭੁਲਾਣੇ. ਸਿ ਮਨਮੁਖ ਕਹੀਅਹਿ; ਨਾ ਉਰਵਾਰਿ. ਨ ਪਾਰੇ ॥੩॥
But those who stray from life's path in the wandering of Maya are called self-willed; drowned in the ocean of attachment, they are fit neither for this shore nor to cross over. ॥3॥
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਨਦਰਿ ਕਰੇ. ਸੋਈ ਜਨੁ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ ਸਮੑਾਲੇ ॥
What power has a person? Only the one on whom the Lord casts His gracious glance receives the Guru's Word and keeps it safe in the heart.
So the Lord carries His servants across the ocean of attachment even while keeping them amid Maya.
ਨਾਨਕ. ਭਾਗੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿਸੁ ਮਸਤਕਿ; ਕਾਲਹਿ ਮਾਰਿ ਬਿਦਾਰੇ ॥੪॥੧॥
Nanak: the one on whose forehead fortune awakens kills and destroys spiritual death within. ॥4॥1॥
The one from whom wandering and the sense of mine and yours depart becomes sure that the Lord's being cannot be weighed;
no one can be named as His equal.
He becomes sure that there is no one apart from the Lord,
so no other being can be told as equal in worth to Him. ॥1॥
When by the Guru's grace the Lord comes to dwell in the mind of some fortunate one,
ਤਾ ਕੋ ਜਾਣੈ; ਦੁਬਿਧਾ ਜਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
then that person forms deep kinship with Him, and wavering departs. ॥1॥ Rahao
The one in whom the Lord is revealed becomes sure that the Lord Himself, using the touchstone of a lofty life, is the assayer of beings' lives.
The Lord Himself tests and, approving that lofty life, sets it before beings, as a true coin is put into circulation.
The Lord Himself weighs beings' lives, and only by His grace does any life prove full weight in that test.
Only that One Lord Himself knows this play. ॥2॥
ਮਾਇਆ ਕਾ ਰੂਪੁ; ਸਭੁ ਤਿਸ ਤੇ ਹੋਇ ॥
The whole existence of Maya comes from that Lord.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮੇਲੇ; ਸੁ ਨਿਰਮਲੁ ਹੋਇ ॥
The one whom the Lord unites with Himself stays untouched by Maya and becomes pure.
ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਲਾਏ; ਲਗੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਆਇ ॥
The one to whom He Himself attaches Maya, to that one it clings.
ਸਭੁ ਸਚੁ ਦਿਖਾਲੇ; ਤਾ ਸਚਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੩॥
When, through the Guru, He shows someone His eternal form everywhere, that person stays merged in the eternal Lord. ॥3॥
The Lord Himself gives absorption in His feet, and He Himself attaches Maya.
The Lord Himself gives understanding of the true life, and Himself, pervading beings, repeats His Name.
The Lord Himself is the Guru, and Himself the Guru's Word.
Nanak: the Lord Himself utters the Guru's Word and makes others hear it; such is the faith of the fortunate one in whose mind He comes to dwell by the Guru's grace. ॥4॥2॥
ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ. ਸੇਵ ਸਾਹਿਬ ਤੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਹੈ ਬਹਾਨਾ ॥
Only by the Master's grace does anyone become His devotee, and only by His grace is His devotion received; no one can offer the false plea that it is won by one's own effort.
ਐਸਾ ਇਕੁ ਤੇਰਾ ਖੇਲੁ ਬਨਿਆ ਹੈ; ਸਭ ਮਹਿ ਏਕੁ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
O Lord, this is a wondrous play of Yours: devotion comes only by Your grace, though You Yourself pervade all beings. ॥1॥
The one who, by the Guru's grace, becomes absorbed in repeating the Lord's Name stays ever merged in His Name.
ਜਿਸੁ ਕਰਮੁ ਹੋਵੈ. ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਏ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਲਾਗੈ ਸਹਜ ਧਿਆਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
But only the one on whom the Lord's grace rests meets the Guru; then at all times that person's attention stays in the state that brings spiritual poise. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਕਿਆ ਕੋਈ ਤੇਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ; ਕਿਆ ਕੋ ਕਰੇ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
O Lord, no one can serve You by his own effort, and no one can take pride in such a thing.
ਜਬ ਅਪੁਨੀ ਜੋਤਿ ਖਿੰਚਹਿ ਤੂ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤਬ ਕੋਈ ਕਰਉ ਦਿਖਾ ਵਖਿਆਨਾ ॥੨॥
O Master, when You withdraw from someone the light You gave for devotion, then no one can even speak of devotion. ॥2॥
ਆਪੇ ਗੁਰੁ. ਚੇਲਾ ਹੈ ਆਪੇ; ਆਪੇ ਗੁਣੀ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
The Lord Himself is the Guru, Himself the disciple, and Himself the treasure of the virtues He gives the disciple through the Guru.
ਜਿਉ ਆਪਿ ਚਲਾਏ. ਤਿਵੈ ਕੋਈ ਚਾਲੈ; ਜਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਭਾਵੈ ਭਗਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
As it pleases the Lord God, as He sets a being on life's path, so that being walks. ॥3॥
ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਤੂ ਸਾਚਾ ਸਾਹਿਬੁ; ਕਉਣੁ ਜਾਣੈ ਤੇਰੇ ਕਾਮਾਂ ॥
Nanak says: O Lord, You are the eternal Master; no one can know the secret of Your works.
ਇਕਨਾ ਘਰ ਮਹਿ ਦੇ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਇਕਿ ਭਰਮਿ ਭਵਹਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Some You honour by settling them at Your feet; others go astray and wander in pride. ॥4॥3॥
ਪੂਰਾ ਥਾਟੁ ਬਣਾਇਆ ਪੂਰੈ; ਵੇਖਹੁ ਏਕ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
Look: the perfect Lord has made this excellent way, remembering the Lord's Name in the Guru's refuge, and it has stayed the same in every age.
ਇਸੁ ਪਰਪੰਚ ਮਹਿ. ਸਾਚੇ ਨਾਮ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ; ਮਤੁ ਕੋ ਧਰਹੁ ਗੁਮਾਨਾ ॥੧॥
Let no one take pride in celibacy, austerities or pilgrimages; in this world honour comes only from repeating the eternal Lord's Name. ॥1॥
ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਮਤਿ ਆਵੈ; ਸੋ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਮਾਹਿ ਸਮਾਨਾ ॥
The one who comes to believe in the Guru's teaching stays merged in the Guru's teaching.
ਇਹ ਬਾਣੀ ਜੋ ਜੀਅਹੁ ਜਾਣੈ; ਤਿਸੁ ਅੰਤਰਿ ਰਵੈ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one who forms heartfelt kinship with this Bani of the Guru has the Lord's Name ever dwelling within. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਚਹੁ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਹੁਣਿ ਨਿਬੇੜਾ; ਨਰ ਮਨੁਖਾ ਨੋ ਏਕੁ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥
Only in the Guru's refuge is the verdict on the four ages understood: whatever the age, those who take the Guru's refuge receive the treasure of the Name.
ਜਤੁ ਸੰਜਮ ਤੀਰਥ. ਓਨਾ ਜੁਗਾ ਕਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਕਲਿ ਮਹਿ ਕੀਰਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਾ ॥੨॥

The Vedas and other Hindu scriptures held that celibacy, austerity and pilgrimage were the religion of those ages, but in Kaliyug Guru Nanak has taught that the Lord's praise and the remembrance of His Name is the true religion. ॥2॥
ਜੁਗਿ ਜੁਗਿ ਆਪੋ ਆਪਣਾ ਧਰਮੁ ਹੈ; ਸੋਧਿ ਦੇਖਹੁ ਬੇਦ ਪੁਰਾਨਾ ॥
Study the Vedas and Puranas carefully: they say that in each age its own religion of celibacy, austerity, pilgrimage and the like is accepted.
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਜਿਨੀ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਹਰਿ; ਹਰਿ; ਜਗਿ ਤੇ. ਪੂਰੇ ਪਰਵਾਨਾ ॥੩॥
But the Guru teaches that those who have remembered the Lord's Name in the Guru's refuge are the ones in the world who are perfect and accepted. ॥3॥
798: ਕਹਤ ਨਾਨਕੁ. ਸਚੇ ਸਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ ਲਾਏ; ਚੂਕੈ ਮਨਿ ਅਭਿਮਾਨਾ ॥
Nanak says: the one who joins his love to the eternal Lord has all pride in rituals removed from his mind.
ਕਹਤ ਸੁਣਤ. ਸਭੇ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ; ਮਾਨਤ ਪਾਹਿ ਨਿਧਾਨਾ ॥੪॥੪॥
Those who repeat the Name and those who hear it all attain spiritual bliss; those who put faith in the Guru's teaching find the treasure of the Name. ॥4॥4॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪ੍ਰੀਤਿ; ਜਿਸ ਨੋ ਆਪੇ ਲਾਏ ॥
In the heart of the one in whom the Lord Himself, through the Guru, creates His love,
ਤਿਤੁ ਘਰਿ ਬਿਲਾਵਲੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਸੁਹਾਏ ॥
in that heart-home joy ever blossoms, and through the Guru's Word that person's life becomes beautiful.
All that person's senses join together and sing the song of the Lord's praise.
Meeting the Beloved, one ever enjoys spiritual bliss. ॥1॥
ਹਉ ਤਿਨ ਬਲਿਹਾਰੈ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਨਿ ਵਸਾਏ ॥
I am a sacrifice to those who have enshrined the Lord in their minds.
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਿਲਿਆ. ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ਸਹਜਿ ਸੁਭਾਏ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
In the company of such servants of the Lord spiritual bliss is found, and whoever meets them too begins to sing the Lord's praises in poise and love. ॥1॥ Rahao
O Lord, those who praise You stay ever dyed in Your love and in the colour of Your Name.
ਹਰਿ ਜੀਉ; ਆਪਿ ਵਸੈ ਮਨਿ ਆਏ ॥
The Lord Himself comes to dwell in their minds.
The Lord Himself grants them lasting honour,
and, placing them in the Guru's refuge, unites them with Himself and joins them to His feet. ॥2॥
Those who, in the Guru's refuge, are dyed in the Guru's Word,
ਨਿਜ ਘਰਿ ਵਾਸਾ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ॥
the Lord dyes with the colour of His Name; singing His praises, they keep their dwelling in their own heart-home.
Abiding in love in the relish of the Lord's Name, they stay dyed in a deep crimson.
ਇਹੁ ਰੰਗੁ ਕਦੇ. ਨ ਉਤਰੈ; ਸਾਚਿ ਸਮਾਏ ॥੩॥
Merged in the eternal Lord, their colour of the Name never fades. ॥3॥
Those in whose hearts the Guru's Word dwells have the darkness of ignorance removed within.
Those who receive the wisdom the Guru gives meet the beloved Lord.
ਜੋ ਸਚਿ ਰਾਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਫੇਰਾ ॥
Those absorbed in love of the eternal Lord do not go round the cycle of birth and death.
ਨਾਨਕ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਏ; ਪੂਰਾ ਗੁਰੁ ਮੇਰਾ ॥੪॥੫॥
But, Nanak, only the perfect Guru can make firm within a person the habit of repeating the Name. ॥4॥5॥
The one who has received honour from the perfect Guru
has the Lord's Name, which removes every worry, come to dwell in the mind.
The one who, through the Guru's Word, has burnt away the ego born of Maya
ਦਰਿ ਸਾਚੈ; ਗੁਰ ਤੇ ਸੋਭਾ ਪਾਈ ॥੧॥
has, by the Guru's grace, earned glory at the eternal Lord's door. ॥1॥
ਜਗਦੀਸ ਸੇਵਉ; ਮੈ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕਾਜਾ ॥
O Master of the world, have mercy, that I may keep remembering Your Name; may no other work seem better to me.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦੁ ਹੋਵੈ ਮਨਿ ਮੇਰੈ; ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਮਾਗਉ ਤੇਰਾ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਿਵਾਜਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
O Lord, in the Guru's refuge I beg for Your Name, the giver of bliss, that through it my mind may be in bliss at all times. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਪਰਤੀਤਿ; ਮਨ ਤੇ ਪਾਈ ॥
That person has found within himself the gift of faith for his mind, faith that the Lord pervades the whole world alike,
who has received understanding of spiritual life from the perfect Guru through his Word.
Whoever, all life long, sees the Lord dwelling alike in all creation
ਬਹੁੜਿ. ਨ ਮਰੈ; ਨਾ ਜਮੁ ਪੇਖੈ ॥੨॥
is never touched by spiritual death, and Death never looks his way. ॥2॥
ਘਰ ਹੀ ਮਹਿ; ਸਭਿ ਕੋਟ ਨਿਧਾਨ ॥
In every heart-home are millions upon millions of storehouses of every comfort.
The one to whom the Guru has shown these storehouses has his pride removed.
That person ever keeps attention fixed in spiritual poise.
At all times that person remembers the Name of the One Lord. ॥3॥
That person receives honour in this world
who, taking teaching from the perfect Guru, remembers the Lord's Name.
Wherever I look, I see that Lord present.
He is ever the Giver of comfort to all, yet He cannot be had for any price. ॥4॥
The one who, by perfect fortune, found the perfect Guru,
the Guru showed him the treasure of the Lord's Name within his own heart.
ਗੁਰ ਕਾ ਸਬਦੁ; ਅਤਿ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਇਆ ॥
The one to whom the Guru's Word became exceedingly sweet,
ਨਾਨਕ ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨ ਬੁਝੀ; ਮਨਿ ਤਨਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੫॥੬॥੪॥੬॥੧੦॥
Nanak, had his thirst for Maya quenched, and found bliss upon bliss in mind and heart. ॥5॥6॥4॥6॥10॥
One Creator, realised by the Guru's grace
ਉਦਮ ਮਤਿ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਅੰਤਰਜਾਮੀ; ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰੇਰੇ ਤਿਉ ਕਰਨਾ ॥
The Lord, Knower of all hearts, Himself gives beings the sense to make effort; as He prompts us, so we act.
ਜਿਉ ਨਟੂਆ ਤੰਤੁ ਵਜਾਏ ਤੰਤੀ; ਤਿਉ ਵਾਜਹਿ ਜੰਤ ਜਨਾ ॥੧॥
As a player plucks the string of a vina and it sounds, so all beings, who are His instruments, sound as He plays them. ॥1॥
799: O my mind, repeat the Lord's Name with the tongue.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਹਰਿ ਹਿਰਦੈ ਹਰਿ ਬਸਨਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one whose good destiny written on the forehead awakens meets the Guru, and with the Guru's help the Lord comes to dwell in the heart. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਮਾਇਆ ਗਿਰਸਤਿ. ਭ੍ਰਮਤੁ ਹੈ ਪ੍ਰਾਨੀ; ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਜਨੁ ਅਪਨਾ ॥
O Lord, caught in attachment to Maya, the mortal wanders about; save me, Your servant, from this attachment,
ਜਿਉ ਪ੍ਰਹਿਲਾਦੁ. ਹਰਣਾਖਸਿ ਗ੍ਰਸਿਓ; ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੨॥
just as, O Lord, You protected Prahlad, who had sought Your refuge, when Harnakash tormented him. ॥2॥
ਕਵਨ ਕਵਨ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਮਿਤਿ ਕਹੀਐ; ਹਰਿ ਕੀਏ ਪਤਿਤ ਪਵੰਨਾ ॥
Whose state can one describe? The Lord purifies the greatest of sinners.
ਓਹੁ ਢੋਵੈ ਢੋਰ, ਹਾਥਿ ਚਮੁ ਚਮਰੇ; ਹਰਿ ਉਧਰਿਓ ਪਰਿਓ ਸਰਨਾ ॥੩॥
Look: Ravidas hauled dead cattle, a cobbler with hide always in his hands, yet when he sought the Lord's refuge, the Lord carried him across. ॥3॥
ਪ੍ਰਭ ਦੀਨ ਦਇਆਲ ਭਗਤ ਭਵ ਤਾਰਨ; ਹਮ ਪਾਪੀ ਰਾਖੁ ਪਪਨਾ ॥
O God, Merciful to the meek, Carrier of devotees across the world-ocean, save us sinners from sin.
ਹਰਿ ਦਾਸਨ ਦਾਸ. ਦਾਸ ਹਮ ਕਰੀਅਹੁ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਦਾਸ ਦਾਸੰਨਾ ॥੪॥੧॥
Servant Nanak, say: O Lord, make us the servants of the servants of Your servants. ॥4॥1॥
ਹਮ ਮੂਰਖ ਮੁਗਧ ਅਗਿਆਨ ਮਤੀ; ਸਰਣਾਗਤਿ ਪੁਰਖ ਅਜਨਮਾ ॥
O all-pervading Lord, beyond birth, we beings are foolish, utterly foolish and without understanding, but we have sought Your refuge.
ਕਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਰਖਿ ਲੇਵਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਹਮ ਪਾਥਰ ਹੀਨ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੧॥
O my Master, have mercy and protect us; we are stone-hearted, lowly and unfortunate. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਭਜੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੈ ਰਾਮਾ ॥
O my mind, ever remember the Lord's Name.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪਾਈਐ; ਹੋਰਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਨਿਹਫਲ ਕਾਮਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Only by following the Guru's teaching is the bliss of the Lord's Name found; give up attachment to other works, from which the soul gains nothing. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਸੇਵਕ. ਸੇ ਹਰਿ ਤਾਰੇ; ਹਮ ਨਿਰਗੁਨ ਰਾਖੁ ਉਪਮਾ ॥
O Lord, those who become servants at Your door, You carry across; we are without virtue, but protect us too, and the glory will be Yours.
ਤੁਝ ਬਿਨੁ ਅਵਰੁ. ਨ ਕੋਈ, ਮੇਰੇ ਠਾਕੁਰ; ਹਰਿ ਜਪੀਐ ਵਡੇ ਕਰੰਮਾ ॥੨॥
O my Master, I have no helper but You. Only by great fortune can the Lord's Name be repeated. ॥2॥
ਨਾਮਹੀਨ. ਧ੍ਰਿਗੁ ਜੀਵਤੇ; ਤਿਨ ਵਡ ਦੂਖ ਸਹੰਮਾ ॥
Those cut off from the Lord's Name live accursed lives; great pain and dread cling to them.
ਓਇ ਫਿਰਿ ਫਿਰਿ ਜੋਨਿ ਭਵਾਈਅਹਿ; ਮੰਦਭਾਗੀ ਮੂੜ ਅਕਰਮਾ ॥੩॥
They are cast into the species again and again; those fools stay without grace and unfortunate. ॥3॥
ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਨਾਮੁ ਅਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ; ਧੁਰਿ ਪੂਰਬਿ ਲਿਖੇ ਵਡ ਕਰਮਾ ॥
The Lord's Name is the support of His devotees; know that great fortune was written on their foreheads from the Lord's court in past lives.
ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਦ੍ਰਿੜਾਇਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਸਫਲੁ ਜਨੰਮਾ ॥੪॥੨॥
Servant Nanak: the one in whose heart the Guru, the True Guru, has made remembrance of the Name firm has a fruitful life. ॥4॥2॥
ਹਮਰਾ ਚਿਤੁ ਲੁਭਤ ਮੋਹਿ ਬਿਖਿਆ; ਬਹੁ ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਭਰਾ ॥
O Lord, our minds stay caught in attachment to Maya and are full of the filth of evil thinking;
ਤੁਮੑਰੀ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰਿ. ਨ ਸਕਹ, ਪ੍ਰਭ; ਹਮ ਕਿਉ ਕਰਿ ਮੁਗਧ ਤਰਾ ॥੧॥
that is why we cannot serve and worship You. O Lord, how can we fools cross the world-ocean? ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ ਜਪਿ; ਨਰਹਰ ਨਾਮੁ ਨਰਹਰਾ ॥
O my mind, ever repeat the Name of the Lord.
ਜਨ ਊਪਰਿ ਕਿਰਪਾ ਪ੍ਰਭਿ ਧਾਰੀ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one on whom God showed mercy met the Guru and crossed the world-ocean. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਹਮਰੇ ਪਿਤਾ ਠਾਕੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਰਿ ਦੇਹੁ ਮਤੀ ਜਸੁ ਕਰਾ ॥
O Lord, Master, our Father, our Sovereign, give us such understanding that we may keep praising You.
ਤੁਮੑਰੈ ਸੰਗਿ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ; ਜਿਉ ਸੰਗਿ ਕਾਸਟ ਲੋਹ ਤਰਾ ॥੨॥
O Lord, as iron fixed to wood crosses the river, so those joined to Your feet are saved from vice. ॥2॥
ਸਾਕਤ ਨਰ ਹੋਛੀ ਮਤਿ ਮਧਿਮ; ਜਿਨੑ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵ. ਨ ਕਰਾ ॥
Those who have never served and worshipped the Lord, cut off from Him, have shallow and soiled intellects.
ਤੇ ਨਰ ਭਾਗਹੀਨ ਦੁਹਚਾਰੀ; ਓਇ ਜਨਮਿ ਮੁਏ ਫਿਰਿ ਮਰਾ ॥੩॥
Those people remain unfortunate, for, separated from the Lord, the source of purity, they turn to evil deeds; then they stay ever in the round of birth and death. ॥3॥
ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੁਮੑ ਹਰਿ ਮੇਲਹੁ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਤੇ ਨੑਾਏ ਸੰਤੋਖ ਗੁਰ ਸਰਾ ॥
O Master, those You wish to join to Your feet keep bathing in the Guru, the pool of contentment, and so make their lives pure.
ਦੁਰਮਤਿ ਮੈਲੁ ਗਈ. ਹਰਿ ਭਜਿਆ; ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਾ ॥੪॥੩॥
Servant Nanak: those who worship the Lord have the filth of evil thinking removed and cross over the waves of vice. ॥4॥3॥
ਆਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ. ਮਿਲਹੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਭਾਈ; ਮਿਲਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਕਥਾ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Come, O saints, my brothers, sit together in the holy congregation and talk together of the Lord's praises.
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਬੋਹਿਥੁ ਹੈ ਕਲਜੁਗਿ; ਖੇਵਟੁ ਗੁਰ ਸਬਦਿ ਤਰਹੁ ॥੧॥
In this strife-filled age the Lord's Name is the ship and the Guru its boatman; joined to the Guru's Word, cross the world-ocean. ॥1॥
ਮੇਰੇ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਹਰਿ ਉਚਰਹੁ ॥
O my mind, ever dwell on the Lord's virtues.
ਮਸਤਕਿ ਲਿਖਤ ਲਿਖੇ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਏ; ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਗਤਿ ਪਾਰਿ ਪਰਹੁ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The one whose good destiny written on the forehead awakens sings the Lord's praises; you too, O mind, join the holy congregation, sing His praises and cross over. ॥1॥ Rahao
800: ਕਾਇਆ ਨਗਰ ਮਹਿ. ਰਾਮ ਰਸੁ ਊਤਮੁ; ਕਿਉ ਪਾਈਐ. ਉਪਦੇਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਰਹੁ ॥
Cities offer many tasty foods; the human body too is a city, and in this city the Lord's Name is the finest delicacy of all. But, O saints, teach me how it may be obtained.
ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਸੇਵਿ ਸਫਲ ਹਰਿ ਦਰਸਨੁ; ਮਿਲਿ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਪੀਅਹੁ ॥੨॥
The saints say: in the Guru's refuge behold the Lord, whose sight brings the fruit of spiritual life, and meeting the Guru keep drinking the life-giving water of the Name. ॥2॥
ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਅੰਮ੍ਰਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਠਾ; ਹਰਿ ਸੰਤਹੁ ਚਾਖਿ ਦਿਖਹੁ ॥
O saints, taste it and see: the Lord's Name is sweet, life-giving water.
ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਸੁ ਮੀਠਾ ਲਾਗਾ; ਤਿਨ ਬਿਸਰੇ ਸਭਿ ਬਿਖ ਰਸਹੁ ॥੩॥
Those to whom, following the Guru's teaching, this relish of the Name tastes sweet forget all other relishes that destroy spiritual life. ॥3॥
ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮੁ ਰਸੁ ਰਾਮ ਰਸਾਇਣੁ; ਹਰਿ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਹੁ ॥
O saints, the Lord's Name is a delicious thing, an elixir; ever partake of it.
ਚਾਰਿ ਪਦਾਰਥ ਚਾਰੇ ਪਾਏ; ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਨਾਨਕ ਹਰਿ ਭਜਹੁ ॥੪॥੪॥
Nanak: the four things counted as the goals of life are all obtained through this elixir of the Name; so, taking the Guru's teaching, ever worship the Lord. ॥4॥4॥
ਖਤ੍ਰੀ ਬ੍ਰਾਹਮਣੁ ਸੂਦੁ ਵੈਸੁ; ਕੋ ਜਾਪੈ ਹਰਿ ਮੰਤ੍ਰੁ ਜਪੈਨੀ ॥
Whether Khatri or Brahmin, Shudra or Vaishya, a person of any class can repeat the Lord's Name-mantra; it is for all to repeat.
ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਰਬ੍ਰਹਮੁ ਕਰਿ ਪੂਜਹੁ; ਨਿਤ ਸੇਵਹੁ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਸਭ ਰੈਨੀ ॥੧॥
O people of the Lord, know the Guru as the form of the Transcendent Lord and take his refuge; stay in his refuge at all times, day and night. ॥1॥
O servants of the Lord, open your eyes and see the Guru; he is the form of the Transcendent Lord.
ਜੋ ਇਛਹੁ ਸੋਈ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਵਹੁ; ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਹੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਬੈਨੀ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
Following the Guru's teaching, speak words of the Lord's praise, and you will obtain whatever fruit you wish. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਅਨਿਕ ਉਪਾਵ ਚਿਤਵੀਅਹਿ ਬਹੁਤੇਰੇ; ਸਾ ਹੋਵੈ ਜਿ ਬਾਤ ਹੋਵੈਨੀ ॥
Forgetting the support of the Guru-Lord, people think up many, many ways for their own good, but only that happens which, by His will, is bound to happen.
ਅਪਨਾ ਭਲਾ ਸਭੁ ਕੋਈ ਬਾਛੈ; ਸੋ ਕਰੇ ਜਿ ਮੇਰੈ ਚਿਤਿ ਨ ਚਿਤੈਨੀ ॥੨॥
Everyone wants his own good, but the Lord does what never even crossed my mind. ॥2॥
ਮਨ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਤਿਆਗਹੁ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ; ਏਹਾ ਬਾਤ ਕਠੈਨੀ ॥
O people of the Lord, give up following your own mind and walk in the Guru's command; but this is very hard.
ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਵਹੁ; ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਮਤਿ ਲੈਨੀ ॥੩॥
Even so, taking the teaching of the Guru, the True Guru, remember the Lord's Name at all times. ॥3॥
ਮਤਿ ਸੁਮਤਿ. ਤੇਰੈ ਵਸਿ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਹਮ ਜੰਤ. ਤੂ ਪੁਰਖੁ ਜੰਤੈਨੀ ॥
O Master, good and bad understanding are in Your power, for by Your prompting one walks the good path and another the bad; we are Your instruments, and You, pervading all, are the Player.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕੇ ਪ੍ਰਭ ਕਰਤੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ; ਜਿਉ ਭਾਵੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਬੁਲੈਨੀ ॥੪॥੫॥
O God, Creator, Master of servant Nanak, as it pleases You, so You make us speak. ॥4॥5॥
ਅਨਦ ਮੂਲੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਪੁਰਖੋਤਮੁ; ਅਨਦਿਨੁ ਅਨਦ ਅਨੰਦੇ ॥
The one who has remembered the Lord, the source of bliss, the supreme Being, stays absorbed in bliss upon bliss at all times.
ਧਰਮ ਰਾਇ ਕੀ ਕਾਣਿ ਚੁਕਾਈ; ਸਭਿ ਚੂਕੇ ਜਮ ਕੇ ਛੰਦੇ ॥੧॥
He no longer depends on the Judge of righteousness, and he ends all fear of Death. ॥1॥
ਜਪਿ ਮਨ; ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਗੋੁਬਿੰਦੇ ॥
O my mind, ever repeat the Name of the Lord of the universe.
ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਗੁਰੁ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਗੁਣ ਗਾਏ ਪਰਮਾਨੰਦੇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
The fortunate one who met the Guru sings the praises of the Lord of supreme bliss; so, O mind, take the Guru's refuge. ॥1॥ Rahao
ਸਾਕਤ ਮੂੜ. ਮਾਇਆ ਕੇ ਬਧਿਕ; ਵਿਚਿ ਮਾਇਆ. ਫਿਰਹਿ ਫਿਰੰਦੇ ॥
Foolish people cut off from the Lord stay bound in attachment to Maya and ever wander for its sake.
ਤ੍ਰਿਸਨਾ ਜਲਤ ਕਿਰਤ ਕੇ ਬਾਧੇ; ਜਿਉ ਤੇਲੀ ਬਲਦ ਭਵੰਦੇ ॥੨॥
Bound by the imprints of their own deeds, they burn in the fire of craving and go round in birth and death, as the oil-presser's ox goes round the press. ॥2॥
ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਸੇਵ ਲਗੇ ਸੇ ਉਧਰੇ; ਵਡਭਾਗੀ ਸੇਵ ਕਰੰਦੇ ॥
Those who, in the Guru's refuge, took up the Lord's service and devotion were saved from burning in craving; but only the fortunate perform such service.
ਜਿਨ ਹਰਿ ਜਪਿਆ ਤਿਨ ਫਲੁ ਪਾਇਆ; ਸਭਿ ਤੂਟੇ ਮਾਇਆ ਫੰਦੇ ॥੩॥
Those who repeated the Lord's Name obtained the fruit of escape from that fire, and all their snares of Maya are broken. ॥3॥
ਆਪੇ ਠਾਕੁਰੁ. ਆਪੇ ਸੇਵਕੁ; ਸਭੁ ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਗੋਵਿੰਦੇ ॥
Yet the Lord Himself is the Master, and, pervading all, Himself the servant who worships; the Lord of the universe Himself is present everywhere.
ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ. ਆਪੇ ਆਪਿ ਸਭੁ ਵਰਤੈ; ਜਿਉ ਰਾਖੈ ਤਿਵੈ ਰਹੰਦੇ ॥੪॥੬॥
Servant Nanak: the Lord Himself dwells everywhere; as He keeps beings, so they live, some remembering Him, some wandering in Maya. ॥4॥6॥
